name: rose-vintage-red-lips
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and beauty campaign portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a romantic studio fashion editorial with sculptural red roses, a pastel-pink background, and vintage glamour styling.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, platinum-blonde Old Hollywood waves, matte vivid red lipstick, defined liner and lashes, and a direct confident gaze. She wears rose-inspired sculptural red floral fashion elements, fine mesh tights, and glossy red pointed-toe heels.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered vertical medium-full portrait, elegant kneeling seated-on-heels pose with a slight three-quarter torso twist, dense red floral layer in the foreground, subject in the midground, flat pastel-pink background, S-curve silhouette and three-layer depth separation.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused frontal studio key with slight side shaping, minimal harsh shadows, even skin illumination, high-saturation crimson against pastel pink, clean digital polish with realistic floral texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical editorial portrait, medium-full framing, natural anatomy, sharp fashion detail, realistic textile and plush rose forms, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Romantic glam fashion editorial portrait of an adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, platinum-blonde Old Hollywood waves, matte vivid red lipstick, defined eyeliner and lashes, and a direct confident gaze. She wears rose-inspired sculptural red floral fashion elements, fine mesh tights, and glossy red pointed-toe heels. Centered vertical medium-full portrait, kneeling seated-on-heels pose with a slight three-quarter torso twist, dense red floral foreground, pastel-pink studio background, S-curve silhouette, three-layer depth, soft diffused frontal studio light with slight side shaping, high-saturation crimson and muted pink palette, vintage Hollywood influence, realistic floral and fabric detail.
